shape: §4.2 flat question list: options are plain strings, label = A + index
subject: english

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I ___ my grandparents during the holidays.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: during the holidays 指刚过去的假期，用一般过去时，visit 的过去式是 visited。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — What did you do last Sunday?  — I ___ to the park.
questions.explanation: 问句用了 did，回答也要用过去式，go 的过去式是 went。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — Where ___ you go last summer?  — I ___ to Hainan.
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句用 did 提问、动词回原形；回答要用过去式，所以第二空是 went。“did; go”错在回答没有用过去式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: He ___ to school by bike every day.
questions.explanation: 主语 He 是第三人称单数，every day 表示习惯，动词加 -es：goes。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My sister ___ her homework after dinner.
questions.explanation: My sister 是第三人称单数，do 要变成 does。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My father ___ TV in the evening, but my parents ___ TV in the morning.
questions.explanation: my father 是单数用 watches，my parents 是复数用 watch。同一句话里两个主语形式不同。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We ___ waste water. Water is useful.
questions.explanation: 水很有用，所以不应该浪费，用 shouldn't + 动词原形 waste。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We should ___ the tap after we wash our hands.
questions.explanation: should 后面接动词原形，不加 -s、-ing 或 -ed。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: You look tired. You ___ go to bed early.
questions.explanation: 对方看起来累，是给建议，用 should；shouldn't 意思相反，can't 表能力，aren't 后不接动词原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.explanation: big 是重读闭音节、末尾只有一个辅音字母，要双写 g 再加 -er：bigger。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: This bird is ___ than the first one.
questions.explanation: 有 than 表示两者比较，用比较级 bigger。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: This book is ___ than that one.
questions.explanation: interesting 是多音节词，比较级在前面加 more，不加 -er，也不能用最高级 most。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — What's wrong with you?  — I ___ a headache.
questions.explanation: 问病情用 What's wrong with you，回答是一般现在时；主语 I 用 have，不用 has。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句表示「我感冒了」，说法正确？
questions.explanation: have a cold 是固定搭配：cold 前要加 a，且 cold 在这里不可数，不能加 -s；be 动词不能和 cold 搭配表示生病。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: You have a cold. You ___ drink more water.
questions.explanation: 感冒了多喝水是建议，用 should + 动词原形；shouldn't 意思相反，can't 表能力，aren't 后不能直接接动词原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: You shouldn't ___ too much ice cream when you have a fever.
questions.explanation: shouldn't 是情态动词的否定形式，后面一律接动词原形，不加 -s、-ing 或 -ed。
